title: Size bound for the search circuit
statement: Let $n,m,S\in\mathbb{N}$, and for each $j\in\mathbb{N}$ let $D_j$ be a Boolean circuit on $n+j$ inputs in which every gate has distinct arguments, every negation gate has exactly one argument, and every gate has at most two arguments. Suppose that for every $j$ with $1\le j\le m$, the size of $D_j$ is at most $S$. Then the size of the multiple-output circuit produced by the search construction from this family after $m$ stages is at most $n+1+m(S+1)$.
